root.name: Van Geet Opening: Gladbacher Gambit
root.moves: 1. Nc3 e5 2. b3 d5 3. e4 dxe4 4. d3

overview: White has played b3 and e4 and now offers the e-pawn with 4.d3, hoping for the bishop pair, a fianchetto on b2 and pressure on e5. Black can take on d3 or hold the pawn with ...f5, usually staying a pawn up. Read from the moves.

white_ideas.idea: Recapture on d3 with Bxd3 and fianchetto with Bb2
Attack e5 with Nge2 and Nf3 using the b2 bishop

black_ideas.idea: Support the extra pawn with ...f5 or ...Nc6

typical_structures.structure: Black pawns on e5 and e4 or d3 against White's b3 fianchetto set-up

character.notes: White gives a pawn and Black has choices that lead to tactics.

gambit.notes: The e-pawn is lost and Black can keep it.

soundness.notes: The compensation is slight against accurate defence.

structure.notes: Pawn exchanges in the centre open lines.

level.notes: Dubious so not Beginner, and little to memorise.
